services.name: KCPT Youth Programs
services.desc: Welcome to KCPT's Professional Theater Training for youth! We offer theater classes and workshops for all ages and skill levels. In this class, students begin foundational theatre techniques through games and exercises, while exploring self-expression and creative play. This class is designed as an introductory course for students who have perhaps expressed an interest in theatre, but have yet to try it! These classes are great for building confidence and learning important social skills. Get ready to laugh, play, move, and explore characters!
